college_info.name: Greenfield Institute of Technology & Science
college_info.accreditation: NAAC A+ Grade | NBA Accredited | AICTE Approved

faqs.question: What is the admission process for undergraduate programs?
faqs.answer: Admissions to B.Tech programs are based on JEE Main scores. Students must: 1) Qualify JEE Main with minimum 75 percentile, 2) Apply online through our portal at www.gits.edu.in, 3) Participate in JOSAA/State counseling rounds, 4) Complete document verification and pay fees. Direct admission (NRI/Management quota) is also available with merit-based selection.

faqs.question: What are the eligibility criteria for B.Tech admission?
faqs.answer: Eligibility for B.Tech: 1) Passed 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics, 2) Minimum 60% aggregate in PCM (55% for SC/ST), 3) Valid JEE Main score, 4) Age limit: 17-25 years as of October 1st of admission year. For lateral entry (B.Tech 2nd year): Diploma in relevant engineering with 60% marks.

faqs.question: When does the admission process start? What are the important dates?
faqs.answer: Key admission dates: Application opens: March 15 | JEE Main exam: January & April sessions | Counseling: June-July | Classes begin: August 1. Visit our website for the complete academic calendar. Late applications may be considered for available seats.

faqs.question: How do I apply for admission online?
faqs.answer: To apply online: 1) Visit www.gits.edu.in/admissions, 2) Register with your email and mobile number, 3) Fill the application form with academic details, 4) Upload required documents (marksheets, photos, ID proof), 5) Pay application fee of Rs.1,000 online, 6) Submit JEE Main scorecard. You'll receive confirmation on your registered email within 48 hours.

faqs.question: Is there a management quota? How does it work?
faqs.answer: Yes, GITS has 15% Management Quota seats. Requirements: 1) 10+2 with PCM minimum 60%, 2) JEE Main score preferred but not mandatory, 3) Apply through college directly, 4) Selection via merit + interview, 5) Higher fee structure applies. Contact admissions office at +91-80-2345-6789 for details.

faqs.question: What undergraduate courses are offered?
faqs.answer: GITS offers the following B.Tech programs (4 years): 1) Computer Science & Engineering (CSE), 2) CSE with AI & Machine Learning, 3) CSE with Data Science, 4) Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), 5) Electrical Engineering (EE), 6) Mechanical Engineering (ME), 7) Civil Engineering (CE), 8) Information Technology (IT), 9) Aerospace Engineering. Each program has intake of 60-120 students.

faqs.question: What postgraduate programs are available?
faqs.answer: GITS offers M.Tech programs (2 years) in: 1) Computer Science, 2) VLSI Design, 3) Power Systems, 4) Structural Engineering, 5) Machine Design. Also: MBA (2 years) with specializations in Marketing, Finance, HR, and Operations. Ph.D programs in all engineering and management disciplines. Admission via GATE/MAT/CAT scores.

faqs.question: Tell me about the Computer Science Engineering program
faqs.answer: CSE Program Highlights: Duration: 4 years | Intake: 120 seats | Specialization tracks: AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Cloud Computing, Full-Stack Development. Curriculum includes: Data Structures, Algorithms, DBMS, OS, Computer Networks, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Cloud Computing, DevOps. Industry-integrated curriculum updated yearly. 100% placement record since 2010.

faqs.question: Are there any diploma or certificate courses?
faqs.answer: Yes, GITS offers: Short-term Certificate Courses (3-6 months): Python Programming, Web Development, Data Analytics, IoT, Cybersecurity, Cloud Computing (AWS/Azure). Professional Diplomas (1 year): Product Management, Data Science, AI & ML. All courses include industry certifications. Available for both students and working professionals.

faqs.question: What is the fee structure for B.Tech programs?
faqs.answer: B.Tech Annual Fee Structure: Tuition Fee: Rs.1,20,000/year | Development Fee: Rs.15,000/year | Lab & Library Fee: Rs.10,000/year | Exam Fee: Rs.5,000/year | Total per year: ~Rs.1,50,000. Total 4-year cost: ~Rs.6,00,000. Hostel (optional): Rs.80,000/year. Management quota: Rs.2,50,000/year. Fees may increase by 5-10% annually.

faqs.question: What is the fee for MBA or M.Tech programs?
faqs.answer: Postgraduate Fee Structure: M.Tech: Rs.90,000/year (2 years total: Rs.1,80,000) | MBA: Rs.1,50,000/year (2 years total: Rs.3,00,000). Fees include tuition, library, and lab charges. Hostel additional: Rs.85,000/year. Ph.D. stipend: Rs.15,000-25,000/month for funded scholars.

faqs.question: What are the payment options for fees?
faqs.answer: Fee Payment Options: 1) Online payment via Net Banking/UPI/Credit/Debit Card at student portal, 2) Demand Draft in favor of 'GITS', 3) EMI options available through partner banks (HDFC, SBI, Axis), 4) Education loan assistance provided, 5) Semester-wise payment option available. Late payment penalty: 2% per month after due date.

faqs.question: What scholarships are available for students?
faqs.answer: GITS Scholarship Programs: 1) Merit Scholarship: Top 5% JEE scorers get 50% tuition waiver, 2) SC/ST/OBC Scholarship: Government scholarships + college fee waiver, 3) Sports Excellence Award: Rs.50,000/year for national-level athletes, 4) Single Parent/Orphan Scholarship: Up to 75% fee waiver, 5) Sibling Discount: 10% for siblings already enrolled, 6) Alumni Children Discount: 15% discount.

faqs.question: How do I apply for scholarships?
faqs.answer: Scholarship Application Process: 1) Download scholarship form from www.gits.edu.in/scholarships, 2) Fill form with required details, 3) Attach documents: marksheets, income certificate, caste certificate (if applicable), 4) Submit to Scholarship Office by September 30, 5) Results announced by October 31. Government scholarships (NSP Portal): Apply at scholarships.gov.in. College scholarships are renewable annually based on academic performance.

faqs.question: Is there any financial aid for economically weaker students?
faqs.answer: Financial Aid for EWS Students: 1) EWS Scholarship: Students with family income < Rs.8 LPA get 30% fee waiver, 2) Free Laptop Scheme: Top 10 students from economically weak backgrounds get free laptops, 3) Work-Study Program: Part-time campus jobs (Rs.5,000-8,000/month), 4) Education Loan tie-ups: SBI, HDFC at 8.5% interest, 5) Zero-interest installment plan for first-generation graduates.

faqs.question: Are hostel facilities available for students?
faqs.answer: GITS Campus Hostels: 4 hostels (2 boys, 2 girls) with total capacity of 2,400 students | AC and Non-AC options | Room types: Single occupancy (Rs.1,20,000/yr), Double (Rs.90,000/yr), Triple (Rs.75,000/yr). Includes: 3 meals/day, WiFi (100 Mbps), Laundry, 24/7 security, CCTV, Biometric entry. Warden and medical staff on campus.

faqs.question: What facilities are available in the hostel?
faqs.answer: Hostel Amenities: Accommodation: Furnished rooms with study table, wardrobe, bed | Food: Multicuisine dining with North/South Indian, Continental options | Sports: Indoor games room, TV lounge, gym | Connectivity: 100 Mbps WiFi, 24/7 power backup | Safety: CCTV surveillance, biometric access, security guards | Health: On-campus medical center, ambulance | Recreation: Cultural rooms, reading room.

faqs.question: Is hostel compulsory? Can I stay outside campus?
faqs.answer: Hostel is NOT compulsory at GITS. Options: 1) On-campus hostel (recommended for freshers), 2) Off-campus paying guest accommodation (Rs.8,000-15,000/month), 3) Rented apartments near campus. For off-campus accommodation: Students must register with the college, provide address proof, and parents must give consent. Day scholars must follow college timings.

faqs.question: What documents are required for admission?
faqs.answer: Documents Required for Admission: 1) 10th marksheet & certificate, 2) 12th marksheet & certificate, 3) JEE Main scorecard, 4) Passport-size photographs (10 copies), 5) Aadhar Card, 6) Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC if applicable), 7) Income certificate (for scholarship), 8) Migration certificate (from previous school), 9) Medical fitness certificate, 10) Allotment letter (from counseling). Originals required for verification, self-attested copies for submission.

faqs.question: Is there a lateral entry admission for diploma holders?
faqs.answer: Lateral Entry (LE) Admission: Eligibility: Diploma in Engineering (3 years) with minimum 60% marks | Entry: Direct admission to 2nd year B.Tech | Intake: 10% of total seats | Admission via: State Lateral Entry Test (SLET) + college counseling | Programs available: CSE, ECE, ME, CE, EE | No JEE required for lateral entry. Apply separately through college website.

faqs.question: What is the application fee? Is it refundable?
faqs.answer: Application Fee: Rs.1,000 (non-refundable) | Admission Confirmation Fee: Rs.10,000 (adjustable against tuition fees) | Seat booking fee: Rs.25,000 (refundable if seat cancelled within 15 days of allotment). Refund Policy: If you withdraw before classes begin: 75% of tuition refunded. After 1 month: No refund. Medical emergency cases considered separately.

faqs.question: What is the duration of B.Tech program?

Course completion requires: 160 credits including theory, practicals, project, and internship.

faqs.question: Tell me about the college history and overview
faqs.answer: About GITS: Established in 1998, Greenfield Institute of Technology & Science is a premier engineering institution in Karnataka. Key milestones: 1998 - Founded with 3 departments, 2005 - NAAC A Grade, 2010 - NBA Accreditation, 2015 - NAAC A+ upgrade, 2018 - 20th Anniversary with new research centers, 2024 - 25+ years of excellence. With 10,000+ students and 50,000+ alumni worldwide, GITS is known for academic excellence and industry connections.
